hooks.command: c=$(cat); case "$c" in *--write*) exit 0;; *db-sql*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"db-sql de solo lectura: no lleva --write"}}';; *) exit 0;; esac

c=$(cat); case "$c" in *git*) case "$c" in *reset*|*clean*|*branch*|*checkout*|*restore*|*push*|*stash*|*worktree*|*filter-*) printf '%s' "$c" | node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/git-guard.js";; esac;; esac

c=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$c" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | sed 's|\\\\|/|g'); case "$f" in */skills/*.md) d=$(dirname "$f")/..; [ -f "$d/scripts/loop/skill-sync.js" ] && (cd "$d" && node agro.js skill-sync) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
